realReviews.author: Janice Mouatt
realReviews.text: Robbie contacted me promptly to give us a quote for construction of two pergolas and general repairs to our recently purchased home .His advice about design and construction of the pergolas followed by and extensive detailed  quote was prompt  and professional. The two tradesmen who undertook the work were courteous, professional and respected our property and privacy .We are delighted with the  finished product which was delivered on time and within budget  . We highly recommend  Robbie and his team for any similar projects,  Jan & Warwick .

realReviews.author: Billie Barron
realReviews.text: Robbie attended to perform a "Make-Safe" after a storm left a hay shed mostly roofless and leaning over. Can't fault his professional and positive attitude. Willing to answer any queries as he worked away on what was left of the shed. He kept me informed of when he would be on-site and he was punctual. I will definitely be getting Robbie and his team to complete repairs once the insurance decides what they are doing.

realReviews.author: Kaye Lindsay
realReviews.text:
Highly recommend Robbie and his team at Clear Cut Carpentry & Maintenance Solutions for their quality workmanship, attention to detail and regular and open communication.
Great value for money service with an excellent outcome!

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your project?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward chat about the job.

faq.a: Send photos, plans or a description through the form, or give us a ring. We'll talk through the options and send a detailed written quote.
Toowoomba and across the Darling Downs. Not sure if you're in range? Just ask.

faq.q: Do you handle insurance and storm repairs?
faq.a: Yes. We can make the site safe after a storm and complete the repairs once your insurer has approved the work.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a time to look at the job.
